reader.requirement: At --std 85 an absolute LINE NUMBER integer-1 places its print line on that page line, in every report group type (RH, PH, CH/DE/CF, PF, RF), as a first or later line of the group, with LINE-COUNTER equal to that number while the line is presented.

edition-consulted.switches: ExceedsThreeSignificantDigits85 (§1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR1) and the 85-only PF relative-first-line refusal (SR9)

GroupLimits(g, model, Edition.DialectLevel): the 85 page-footing final LINE-COUNTER (Cobol85FinalLineCounter) sets the report footing's upper limit; the 85-only SR9 one-page check of relative body groups
the multiple LINE clause and LINES/NUMBERS/ARE spellings are 2002 constructs, refused at 85 (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: The runtime placement path (FirstLineTarget, SubsequentTarget, PresentLine) consults no edition: grep of src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/Report*.cs for Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect finds only four DialectBehavior questions (sum size error, group indicate, CF page-group control values, TERMINATE save location), none on line placement.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: placement of an absolute line is the same code and the same output at --std 85 and --std 2023 (ln_types at both editions printed identical pages); only the compile-time operand screens differ.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f29_02 covers absolute lines in a detail group only; absolute lines in RH, PH, PF, RF NEXT PAGE and after a page advance are not exercised by it

probes.printed: PAGE 1 LINE 09 [A909] / PAGE 1 LINE 17 [PF17] / PAGE 2 LINE 09 [A909] after a page advance; SOURCE LINE-COUNTER equals the physical line on every line
probes.expected: absolute LINE 9 and PF LINE 17 on lines 9 and 17 of each page (GR3)

probes.printed: PH LINE 2 on line 2 of pages 1-6; DE-4 LINE 6 on line 6 of pages 4 and 6; PF LINE 21 on line 21 of every page
probes.expected: absolute lines of PH, DE and PF on their integer lines

probes.printed: error COBOL2386: LINE 0: the integer operand 0 shall be nonzero (§1985:III.2)
probes.expected: refused: an absolute line number of zero is not an integer this format allows

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: multiple LINE ... requires COBOL-2002 (accepted at --std 2023)
compiles at 85 and 2023 (LINE 5 ON NEXT PAGE NEXT GROUP PLUS 2)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR3  (3.15.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3 ("An absolute line number specifies the line number on which the print line is presented")

reader.notes: Every group type places an absolute line on integer-1, both as the first line and as a later line. LINE-COUNTER equals the line during presentation. g85_f29_02 matches its golden. The runtime arm is shared with 2023 and gives identical output at both editions.

refuter.evidence: absall (--std 85): RH 'LINE NUMBER IS 1' on 1; CH with lines 'LINE NUMBER 4' / 'LINE 5' / 'LINE IS PLUS 1' on 4,5,6; CF absolute LINE 10 on 10 of each page; CH LINE 4 after the CF at LC 10 advanced to page 2 line 4 (fit test 3a); RF absolute LINE 14 on 14; SOURCE LINE-COUNTER equals the physical line on every line, and the optional NUMBER/IS words are accepted. abs999: PAGE LIMIT 999 with lines 998 'NEXT PAGE' (no ON) and 999 printed on 998/999 of pages 1 and 2, LC 999 (three significant digits, the largest). cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR3 ("An absolute line number specifies the line number on which the print line is presented").
